exposure: ARRIVE trial (A Randomized Trial of Induction Versus Expectant Management)
cohort: Nulliparous individuals with a singleton pregnancy, cephalic presentation, without chronic hypertension, diabetes (gestational or pregestational), and fetal anomaly who delivered between 39 and 42 weeks' gestation in the United States from 2015 to 2021
finding: An increase in induction of labor at 39 weeks' gestation in individuals with BMI ≥40 kg/m(2) was not associated with a decrease in the cesarean delivery rate.
